  2. Gildan

    For 40 years, Gildan has been a trusted leader in the apparel industry, delivering high-quality and durability in every garment.   3. What makes our products unique?

    At Gildan we source our cotton, spin yarn, knit dye and craft garments with care for the earth and its sustainability. Choose Gildan for fashion that feels good and does good.

Product Description

Gildan Cotton Stretch Crew Tee Shirts deliver a premium fit and feel. Undershirts made using soft cotton and tag-free design will feel great dressed up or down. Gildan brand delivers high quality apparel choices for any wearing occasion - check out our full line of Gildan apparel today!

Gildan is one of the world's largest vertically integrated manufacturers of apparel and socks. Gildan uses cotton grown in the USA, which represents the best combination of quality and value for Gildan cotton and cotton blended products. Since 2009, Gildan has proudly displayed the cotton USA mark, licensed by cotton council international, on consumer's product packaging and shipping materials. Gildan environmental program accomplishes two core objectives: reduce our environmental impact and preserve the natural Resources being used in our manufacturing process. At all operating levels Gildan is aware of the fact that we operate as a part of a greater unit: the environment in which we live and work.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

5 out of 5 stars
Highest quality for long lasting comfort, keeps its shape and doesn't fade once dyed.
Definitely recommend. May be warmer in the heat than the standard cotton, but these are softer and will last much longer. They also hold their shape better than standard cotton T's, and if you're doing any kind of textile design, this cotton absorbs and holds color very well. Even the packaging is very different from standard t's. Where you can fit a standard T in a little gallon bag for ten of them rolled up. you'd need a much bigger container for these.

    These are amazing tees. I looked at tons of reviews. None were good. Either tees were too small, too thin or too short. And let's not talk about the price for big and tall tees, robbery!!! My son is a big guy 6'1' and 360lbs, Broad shoulders. He's starting a new job and he needed plain tee shirts. I got super frustrated. Then I saw these... a 10 pack of Gildan black tees, and I kept thinking I'd seen this name before at Walmart, but I wasn't for sure. I was so dispondant from all the bad reviews of the tees I had looked at, I was getting afraid to order. Well, I took a chance and went ahead and ordered them. Omg...I did order a 5x, but they are too big...but not too bad, I will see if they shrink. I hope so. But to me this wasn't a bad thing. Because these are the greatest quality tees I've seen in a long time. Great for winter, the material is thick, not too thick , but will be great for work. They are a great length, perfect. I'm ordering a 4x next time, but I couldn't be more pleased. I bet he could even get into a 3x. I mean honestly, you can't beat the price. And the quality. $3.40 a shirt, where are you going to find that? I'm ordering another 10pack later this week. I'll see how these wash up, before I do the review on those...so stay tuned....but you really can't go wrong. My next adventure is big and tall men's pants for work. Lol that was just as bad, wish me luck. lol

    These Gildan T-shirts have that classic heavy-duty feel to them while still being breathable and comfortable to wear. The material feels soft to the touch, and they strike a really good balance between durability and comfort, which honestly is why I keep coming back to them.

    They fit perfect and true to size!

    For me personally, I mainly use these as undershirts underneath hoodies and heavier layers rather than as my everyday standalone T-shirt. They work perfectly for that because they’re comfortable without feeling overly thin or flimsy. That being said, they’re definitely versatile enough to wear casually on their own if you want to.

    What I appreciate most is just the overall comfort and reliability of them. These are the kind of shirts you can throw into heavy laundry rotation and not constantly worry about them falling apart after a few washes. They really do hold up well in the washer and dryer over time.

    I happened to get these during a really good Black Friday sale, which made the value even better, but honestly, I would still recommend them at normal retail pricing because the quality is genuinely there. These are just dependable, comfortable shirts that do exactly what they’re supposed to do.

    Ein absolutes Must-Have in jedem Kleiderschrank!

    Ich bin begeistert von dem Gildan Unisex T-Shirt und möchte meine Erfahrungen gerne mit anderen teilen. Dieses T-Shirt hat mich wirklich überzeugt und ist zu einem unverzichtbaren Teil meiner Garderobe geworden.

    Passform und Komfort:

    Die Passform dieses T-Shirts ist einfach perfekt. Es schmiegt sich angenehm an meinen Körper an, ohne dabei zu eng oder zu locker zu sitzen. Das Unisex-Design ist großartig, da es für Männer und Frauen gleichermaßen geeignet ist. Das Material fühlt sich auf der Haut angenehm weich an und ist gleichzeitig sehr strapazierfähig. Selbst nach mehreren Wäschen hat sich die Qualität nicht verschlechtert. Ich liebe es, wie bequem dieses T-Shirt ist, und es eignet sich perfekt für den Alltag oder für sportliche Aktivitäten.

    Vielseitigkeit:

    Ein weiterer großer Vorteil dieses T-Shirts ist seine Vielseitigkeit. Man kann es zu so vielen verschiedenen Anlässen tragen. Ob als lässiges Outfit mit Jeans und Sneakers oder unter einem Blazer für einen schickeren Look - dieses T-Shirt passt immer. Die Farbauswahl ist beeindruckend, sodass für jeden Geschmack und jeden Stil etwas dabei ist.

    Qualität und Haltbarkeit:

    Die Qualität dieses T-Shirts hat mich wirklich beeindruckt. Die Nähte sind gut verarbeitet, und es hat sich selbst nach mehrmaligem Tragen und Waschen nicht verzogen oder verfärbt. Es behält seine Form und Farbe bei, was für ein Kleidungsstück in dieser Preisklasse beeindruckend ist. Die Haltbarkeit ist definitiv ein Pluspunkt, denn ich habe bereits andere T-Shirts ausprobiert, die nach kurzer Zeit verschlissen waren. Dieses T-Shirt hingegen bleibt in Top-Zustand.

    Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis:

    Das Gildan Unisex T-Shirt bietet ein unschlagbares Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis. Die Qualität, die Passform und der Komfort, den man erhält, stehen in einem großartigen Verhältnis zum Preis. Man bekommt ein hochwertiges T-Shirt zu einem erschwinglichen Preis.

    Fazit:

    Ich kann das Gildan Unisex T-Shirt uneingeschränkt empfehlen. Es ist bequem, vielseitig, strapazierfähig und bietet ein hervorragendes Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis. Dieses T-Shirt ist ein absolutes Must-Have in jedem Kleiderschrank. Ich habe bereits mehrere davon in verschiedenen Farben, und sie enttäuschen mich nie. Kaufen Sie es und Sie werden es nicht bereuen!

About this Item

  • Classic fit for loose comfort
  • Versatile mid-weight fabric for year-round wear
  • Our most popular t-shirt
  • Non-topstitched, classic width, rib collar
  • Tear away label for customizable comfort
  • Screen printing, embroidery, iron-on transfers, bleaching and tie dyE

Product Description

This Adult Heavy Cotton T-shirt is Gildan’s best seller for a reason — wearers love the weight and versatility of the fabric, and there are companion styles for women, youth and toddlers. Made of U.S. Grown cotton, this midweight takes you through every season of the year. Its 100% cotton surface is ideal for screen printing, embroidery, iron-on transfers, bleaching and tie dye. A fantastic choice when you want to coordinate looks for the entire family.
